summary: #poetryport #clmooc #smallpoems thanks I feel as we peel away onions in us bunions on heels of truth stray pinwheels frozen in winds blowing keels hued in poetic thought gratitude of lying bards in search of exactitude sighing guards on a perch of poetic preludes
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
#poetryport
#clmooc
#smallpoems
thanks I feel
as we peel away onions
in us
bunions on heels of truth
stray pinwheels
frozen in winds
blowing keels
hued in poetic thought
gratitude of
lying bards in search of
exactitude
sighing guards on a perch of
poetic preludes
